job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities


Design, develop, test, and deploy AI models using various machine learning algorithms such as regression, classification, clustering, etc.

Develop deep learning models including CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, GANs for image processing, natural language processing, speech recognition tasks.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.

Conduct data analysis and visualization to identify trends and insights from large datasets.

Stay up-to-date with latest advancements in artificial intelligence research and apply them to real-world problems.


Desired Candidate Profile


2-5 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence or related field.

Strong understanding of Generative AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning concepts.

Experience working on projects involving Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision.



Location: Pan India
